Expands revenue lines via Fannie Mae DUS and Freddie Mac Optigo participation.
MSRs add fee income and can diversify earnings vs. spread income.
Joins Fannie DUS and Freddie Optigo
Enables scalable multifamily originations with GSE backing.
Appoints Vince Toye to lead unit
Experienced hire from JPMorgan/Wells reduces execution risk.
Accelerates integration and near-term production capacity.

This is an early-stage expansion move into agency multifamily, adding fee-based and origination capacity to Zions’ capital markets unit. A larger catalyst would require disclosed production targets, financial contribution, or tangible originations/MSR growth data post-integration.
